subject: App crashes when exporting data
body:
Hello,

Your app crashes every time I try to export my data. I see the error:
'Export failed: internal server error'

This happens on macOS 14.2 with the latest version.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open the app
2. Click Export
3. Select CSV format
4. App crashes

Please fix this soon, it's blocking my workflow.

Thanks

subject: Love your product!
body:
Hi,

I just wanted to say thank you for the amazing product. It has completely transformed how I work. Keep up the great work!

Best regards

subject: Feature request: dark mode support
body:
Hi team,

It would be great to have a dark mode option in the app. Many of us work late and the bright interface can be straining.

Would love to see this in a future release.

Thanks

subject: Login page broken after update
body:
After the latest update, I cannot log in. The page shows an error: 'Authentication failed: session token invalid'. Cleared cache, tried incognito, still broken.

Please help.
